name: auto-handoff
description: Hands the conversation off once the context passes a threshold (40% of windows over 200k tokens, 50% of smaller ones): a dedicated turn writes the handoff and the durable knowledge it names into an OKF bundle at .auto-handoff/, then the context is cleared and the work continues from the handoff

largeWindowPercent.title: Handoff threshold for windows over 200k tokens
largeWindowPercent.description: Percent of the context window at which the conversation is handed off when the window is larger than 200k tokens.

smallWindowPercent.title: Handoff threshold for windows up to 200k tokens
smallWindowPercent.description: Percent of the context window at which the conversation is handed off when the window is 200k tokens or smaller.
